subject: planner: make the logical op's shallow ref generator. (#59124)
summary: Adds a new code generator and generated helpers to create shallow-ref (copy-on-write style) slice copies for selected `logicalop.LogicalJoin` condition fields via a `shallow-ref:"true"` struct tag, plus wiring for `go generate`/Bazel. No planner runtime correctness/semantics changes are introduced by this commit beyond adding unused helper methods and tags.
